title: Apply 5 targeted fixes to Leave Application Generator

requirements.summary: Add back 'Parent / Guardian Name' field next to 'Student Name' with equal width and required validation
acceptanceCriteria: Parent / Guardian Name field is visible in the form
It appears to the right of Student Name on the same row
Both fields share equal width (50% each)
Field is required and shows validation error if left empty on submit
Styling matches the Student Name field exactly

file_operations.description: Add the 'Parent / Guardian Name' input field with state management (parentGuardianName). Place it in a flex row with 'Student Name', each field taking 50% width using flex-1 or w-1/2. Apply the same input styling, label structure, and required validation as the 'Student Name' field. Update the form submission to include parentGuardianName in the letter generation logic.

requirements.summary: Move 'Class / Grade' field to the right of 'School / Institution Name' maintaining two-row layout
acceptanceCriteria: Class / Grade no longer appears beside Student Name
Class / Grade appears to the right of School / Institution Name on the same row
Row 1 shows Student Name and Parent / Guardian Name
Row 2 shows School / Institution Name and Class / Grade
No styling changes applied to either field

file_operations.description: Restructure the JSX layout to move 'Class / Grade' from its current position to a flex row with 'School / Institution Name'. Ensure Row 1 contains Student Name and Parent / Guardian Name, and Row 2 contains School / Institution Name and Class / Grade. Use the same flex layout (flex-1 or w-1/2) for both fields in Row 2. Do not modify field styling or validation logic.

requirements.summary: Move Language dropdown to the same row as 'Recipient Type' with 50% width each
acceptanceCriteria: Language dropdown no longer appears at the bottom of the form
Language dropdown is on the same row as Recipient Type
Recipient Type takes 50% width, Language takes 50% width
All language options remain functional
Existing dropdown styling is unchanged

file_operations.description: Move the Language dropdown (select element) from its current bottom position to a flex row with 'Recipient Type'. Apply flex-1 or w-1/2 to both Recipient Type and Language dropdowns so each takes 50% width. Ensure all existing language options, state management, and styling remain unchanged.

requirements.summary: Add Clear button to output section that clears preview content without affecting input fields or reloading page
acceptanceCriteria: Clear button is present in the output section after Download PDF
Clicking Clear removes the generated letter preview text
Page does not reload when Clear is clicked
All input fields retain their values after clicking Clear
Copy, Download TXT, and Download PDF buttons are still present and functional

file_operations.description: Add a 'Clear' button to the output section button group, positioned after the 'Download PDF' button. The button order must be: Copy | Download TXT | Download PDF | Clear. Implement a handleClear function that sets the generatedLetter state to an empty string (or null) to clear the preview content. Do not reload the page, navigate away, or reset any input field state. Apply consistent button styling to match existing output buttons.

requirements.summary: Fix Download PDF button to prevent page freezing with async handler, loading state, and error handling
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Download PDF does not freeze or lock the page
PDF is generated and downloaded on a single click
Button is disabled immediately upon click and re-enabled after completion or error
A loading state (e.g., 'Generating…') is shown on the button while PDF is being created
Multiple rapid clicks do not trigger multiple PDF generations
Errors during PDF generation are caught and the button is re-enabled
No page reload occurs during or after PDF generation

file_operations.description: Refactor the Download PDF button click handler to be async with event.preventDefault(). Add isGeneratingPdf state to track loading. Disable the button immediately on click by setting isGeneratingPdf to true. Replace the button label with 'Generating…' while isGeneratingPdf is true. Wrap the PDF generation logic in a try/catch block and ensure isGeneratingPdf is set to false in both success and error paths using finally. Prevent multiple rapid clicks by checking isGeneratingPdf before starting generation. Ensure the page remains responsive throughout.

Review and refactor the PDF export function to ensure it returns a Promise and does not contain blocking synchronous operations or infinite loops. Ensure the function is fully async-compatible and can be awaited in the page component. If html2pdf is used, ensure the promise chain is properly returned and does not hang.
